[spoiler=The Exchange][b][i]The Western View Paper[/i][/b] 
On Thursday July 24 Western View and Eastornia-Kolionia came to an agreement, the Western View government would partially take control of the largest island that Eastornia-Kolionia holds (Hajiu) as well as a large amount of phosphorus and gas (around 100,000 lbs of phosphorus, and 1,000,000 kilograms of gas). Citizens are invited to move there, and only follow Wessern rules, but the island is still inhabited by Kolionians and owned by Eastornia-Kolionia. The reason why Eastornia-Kolionia won't just hand over the island, is because they still want to get their worth out of it, before it "falls into foreign hands" states Emperor Kahang Von Freedban, who is notorious for not trusting anyone, even fellow IPEA members. Western View states "We need this land for resources and for more ability to grow, but we don't want to take it violently, and it turns out Eastornia-Kolionia wants what we have, oil" says Tony Messiaon. In fact, Western View will give 100,000,000 lbs of oil to Eastornia-Kolionia, who so far has no oil at all.

The next day, citizens of Western View started to set up camp, many have to wait for their houses to be ready, so most Wesserns live in hotels, or SkyBNB's, others have started building their houses in the little Kolionian wilderness left, which was a surprise to many Wesserns, seeing how they live with forests in their back yard, even in big cities like Wessernia. Tony Messiaon stated, "Though this land has been damaged by the great Kolionian government, we shall not blame them, they have the right to do what ever they want on their land." This led to a public out cry near the capital complex, luckily Western View has already started planting new forests. They aren't only planting forests their, they're also 'planting' military bases, moistly for IPEA. As the protests continue back home, we hope that this will lead to successes and to an even closer bond to our friends in Elseyr.
[/spoiler]
